videos.caption: AI can already cut, caption and format a clip for you. Free GitHub skills teach Claude the editing part in minutes. So why isn't everyone going viral off podcast clips? Because editing was never the hard part. Choosing the moment is. AI does not know which 47 seconds out of a two hour conversation deserve to become the clip. No context. No content intelligence. Here is how you build that layer. Scrape the latest 100 clips from the biggest podcast short form accounts. Steven Bartlett, Chris Williamson, Alex Hormozi, anyone running serious long form volume. Capture views, post date, duration, transcript, text overlay and format. Then scrape their original long form episodes and pull the complete transcripts with timestamps. The timestamps are non negotiable. They are what lets Claude match every clip back to the exact episode and the exact moment it came from. Now you reverse engineer the decision. Why those 47 seconds. Where the clip starts. What context got removed. Whether the payoff moved forward. What spoken hook, text overlay and format they used. And how it performed against that account's normal clips. Run enough of these and the patterns surface. Turn the patterns into a Claude skill that understands how the best podcast teams select and package their clips. Then hand it any new timestamped transcript. It returns the strongest moments, exact timestamps, hook options, text overlays, formats and editing instructions. The editing skill does the easy part. None of this needs new software. The tools exist. The clipping skills exist. The data is public. Nobody is assembling it into an intelligence layer. Impossible to fail does not mean every clip goes viral. It means every clip starts with real evidence, and every result makes the next selection smarter. Build the selection layer first. The edit is the easy bit.

These 6 prompt add-ons help AI ask better questions, copy your taste, spot weak thinking, and check its work. 1. ELI10 Add this when an answer feels too hard. Comment “Setup” and I’ll send you my setup 👇 5 things you need to do immediately when you start using ChatGPT. ChatGPT Work At the top, you’ll see Chat and Work. Choose Work. This mode actually completes full end to end tasks for you, like building spreadsheets or documents. Plugins On the left, select Plugins. You’ll see all the apps you use every day like Gmail, Google Calendar, and Indeed. Install the ones you use. Protect Your Data Settings → Data Controls. Make sure “Improve the model for everyone” is turned off. Custom Instructions Settings → Personalization. Tell ChatGPT who you are, what you do, and anything else it should save to its memory. The Browser On the desktop app, go to Settings → Browser and turn on “Let ChatGPT control the built in browser.” This lets it access sites you already use without logging in every time. #chatgpt #ai #chatgpttips #chatgpthacks #aitools
